newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech cbank sets 1-wk rev repo, max 29 pct(31pct).
newsitem.headline: Czech cbank sets 1-wk rev repo, max 29 pct(31pct).

text.p: The Czech National Bank (CNB) on Friday set a one-week reverse repo tender to drain funds from the market at a maximum rate of 29 percent, down from 31 percent in a similar operation on Wednesday.
The CNB said it would accept two bids from participants of a minimum 100 million crowns until 10.10 a.m. (0810 GMT) in the operation.
The central bank has been holding several tenders on almost a daily basis over the past few weeks in order to drain liquidity from the market and help support the crown.

The CNB has restricted banks from access to Lombard credit, after raising it to 50 percent from 14 percent. It has also informally limited foreign banks' access to the money market and raised its discount rate to 13 percent from 10.5 percent.
